_meta.description: Read-back proof of the io.datahub.agentMemory.learnings structured property values on the real dim_customers dataset urn, captured after actually executing the SPEC.md S8 / skill/datahub-memory/SKILL.md Conflict Procedure end-to-end: (1) verified the 47% customer_id NULL rate by direct SQL query against the live warehouse, (2) wrote the join_path learning below via add_structured_properties (read-merge-write against a confirmed-empty starting list), (3) ran a real backfill migration (UPDATE ecommerce.dim_customers SET customer_id = customer_key WHERE customer_id IS NULL) that changed the NULL rate to 0.0, (4) marked the original record's status disputed in a read-merge-write that touched only the status field, then (5) wrote a second, new record with status=conflict and conflicts_with pointing at the disputed record's id. Both records below are exactly what add_structured_properties wrote and GraphQL read back -- not hand-authored. The environment was restored after capture; see examples/README.md for full provenance and why this state is a snapshot, not something currently live.
_meta.produced_by: demo-seed/conflict-example (scripted seed run, producing this repo's examples/ deliverable)
_meta.method: DataHub MCP server (uvx mcp-server-datahub@latest, TOOLS_IS_MUTATION_ENABLED=true) called over stdio: add_structured_properties for each of the two conflict-procedure writes, then raw GraphQL (entity { structuredProperties { properties { values } } }) for this readback.
_meta.each_value_below: Shown parsed for readability. On the wire each is a single-line JSON string (json.dumps(..., separators=(',', ':'))) -- that raw string form is what DataHub actually stores as one structured-property value, reproduced verbatim in raw_wire_values.

learnings.claim: customer_id was backfilled from customer_key on 2026-07-29; now 0% NULL — prior join guidance may be stale, but backfill correctness is unverified
